title: Growing degree-days from daily minimum and maximum temperatures — degree_days
text: sine triangle methods evaluated closed-form expressions; hourly temperatures generated. "average": \(\max(0, (T_{max} + T_{min}) / 2 - T_b)\) (McMaster & Wilhelm 1997, method 1). upper threshold cutoff applied daily mean. "modified_average": extremes bounded averaging, \(T^*_{min} = \min(\max(T_{min}, T_b), T_u)\) \(T^*_{max} = \min(\max(T_{max}, T_b), T_u)\), GDD \(= (T^*_{max} + T^*_{min}) / 2 - T_b\) (McMaster & Wilhelm 1997, method 2; "86/50" method maize \(T_b = 10\) \(T_u = 30\) degrees C). Without upper \(T_b\) bounds extremes. Raising \(T_{min}\) \(T_b\) counts days whose mean base \(T_{max} > T_b\), unlike "average". bound extremes method's upper-threshold rule, cutoff = "horizontal" accepted. "ensemble": weighted mean daily methods , weights estimated observed data gdd_ensemble_weights() passed weights. default weights. gdd_ensemble() also returns members spread. "single_sine": sine wave tmin tmax 24 h (Baskerville & Emin 1969). "single_triangle": symmetric triangle tmin tmax (Lindsey & Newman 1956; Sevacherian et al. 1977). "double_sine", "double_triangle": day split two half-day segments: tmin tmax day, tmax minimum following day (tmin_next). half contributes half day (Allen 1976; Zalom et al. 1983).

title: Growing degree-days from daily minimum and maximum temperatures — degree_days

"vertical": development temperature exceeds \(T_u\); whole area curve hours removed. "intermediate": development decreases linearly \(T_u\) slope -1 (area \(T_u\) subtracted second time), rate floored zero. floor matters temperatures exceed \(2T_u - T_b\). three cutoffs coincide temperatures stay upper give different results otherwise; interchangeable.
